parameters.content:
## Setup before activating
1. Import & activate **IT Ticketing - Error Notifier** first.
2. Create Outlook folders (mailbox root): **Inbox**, **Open Tickets**, **Processed**.
3. Open every **Move** node and reselect the correct folder (folder IDs are tenant-specific).
4. Upload `IT Support Tickets.xlsx` (v2.0) to OneDrive/SharePoint; open every **Excel** node and reselect workbook + Tickets/ITTickets + Audit Log/AuditLog.
5. Add **OpenRouter** (or swap to Groq) credential on **OpenRouter Chat Model**.
6. Workflow Settings → **Error Workflow** → Error Notifier.
7. Workflow Settings → **Concurrency** → `1` (no Excel lock sheet).
8. Confirm Outlook Trigger watches Inbox.
9. Update self-send filter email in Extract node if mailbox differs.

## Debug map (left → right)
1. Trigger → one email per execution
2. Extract → shouldProcess / priority / CCs
3. Drop → Processed (self/OOO)
4. Lookup ConversationID
   • exists + Ack=Yes → move Open Tickets
   • exists + Ack≠Yes → resume reply → update → move
5. New: Generate ID → uniqueness ≤5 → Data Guard
6. Invalid → Needs Review row → Open Tickets
7. Valid → AI summarize → Excel create (Ack=No) → Audit
   → Reply → Graph PATCH Ack → move → Graph PATCH Complete

Excel Table has no update op (n8n docs). Stage flags use getRows + HTTP PATCH Graph range. Concurrency=1. See WORKFLOW_GUIDE.md.
